title: Haye Masmoon Raza Haye Ghareebul Ghoraba
body:
Haye masmoon Raza haye gharibul ghuraba, zaher zalim ne diya haye gharibul ghurabaa
Athwan mohre imamat tha shahe har do sara, haye kya waqt tha mazloom pa dekha na gaya, khaate hi zehre dagha dil hua para para, goonj uthi shahe qhurasaan mein har so ye sada, haye masmoon Raza haye gharibul ghuraba
Ayi massoma-e-qhum bhaiyi se apne milne, muztarib log hue kaun batayein jaake, aap ayein hain watan se yahan milne jisse, na raha shahe qhurasaan ka sar par saya, haye masmoon Raza haye gharibul ghuraba
Roote sar peet te hai chahane waale paiham, hum bhi mil jaye issi gham mein basad didainam, aur dua Fatima deti hi rahegi har dam, aati hain Fatima lene ko yaha ashk ke azaa, haye masmoon Raza haye gharibul ghuraba
<<DIVIDER>>
Zaher ka tha wo asar looth rahe the moula, aake ghar qhaey jo hui mooh se lahu jari tha, dil ko pakde hue kehte the ab ao baba, aakhiri waqt hai dam toot raha hai mera, haye masmoon Raza haye gharibul ghuraba
Paas koi nahin kya aalame tanhaayi hain, na to qidhmat ke liye paas koi bhayi hai, ab qhurasaan mein bas gham ki faza chhayi hai, log har simt se niklenge basad aah-o-buka, haye masmoon Raza haye gharibul ghuraba
Tha sohail chaaron taraf gham ka manzar, bhayi ke gham mein rahein Fatima har pal muztar, kehti thi peet ke sar ab na jiyegi qawhar, bhayi ke baad huyi Fatima duniya se juda, haye masmoon Raza haye gharibul ghuraba
